item.title: Quincy commissioners terminate city attorney following police chief's removal
item.description: Quincy city commissioners terminated their city attorney Tuesday, citing a conflict of interest involving a former city manager. This comes just one week after the police chief's termination.

item.title: Local nonprofit launches summer program to help neurodiverse youth learn job skills through creative media
item.description: Infinite Spectrum Foundation is offering a new filmmaking and podcasting program for neurodiverse youth ages 11-22. It focuses on job skills and community building using creative media.

item.title: Lowndes County Commissioners approve road & emergency preparedness projects
item.description: Lowndes County commissioners approved infrastructure spending projects during their Tuesday meeting. Residents also voiced concerns about rapid development, data centers, and recycling programs.
